Bail Bloc

2017–2021
Software, social practice, intervention

Bail Bloc is an application that mines cryptocurrency in the background of everyday computer use. The artist conceived the project and led its software development, working with The New Inquiry as publishing partner. The Monero it mines is pooled, exchanged for US dollars at the end of each month, and donated in full to the Bronx Freedom Fund, which uses it to post bail for low-income and marginalized people in New York City. In its first month, Bail Bloc ran on about 1,500 computers and raised over $3,300. Spare processing power becomes bail money, a steady transfer from computers that would otherwise sit idle to people held in jail because they cannot pay.
